title: The Smile of Cold Spring
author: Beatrix Reyes
blurb: Noor Vasquez, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
